Sam (AE): Quick syncClient asks for SOC2 artifact bundle + a signed pen-test attestation for a 45-day POC. Also want staging IP allowlist and confirmation on BYOK for keys. Can we do BYOK for a short POC?

Nina (Solutions): We can provide a redacted SOC2 package under NDA. Staging allowlist is fine, send CIDRs. BYOK requires Dedicated or Private; not available on hosted. Lead time ~10 business days to provision Dedicated for POC.

Omar (Security): Attestation: we issue a signed letter stating an external pentest date and whether critical findings were found. Full reports require a disclosure addendum and are exception-based. Need exact legal entity name + scope statement. If PII/PHI is in scope note that up front.

Sam (AE): They want an answer today for procurement about BYOK and whether the attestation can name their company.

LegalBot: Template attestation uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/docs/attestation_template.pdf. Legal: signature turnaround once we have customer name and scope (~2-4 business days).

Nina (Solutions): Pricing note: short-term Dedicated for small GPU footprint ballpark $9kkmonth; exact quote after finance review.

Omar (Security): Action items: 1) Sam get customer legal name; 2) ask for staging CIDRs; 3) confirm if regulated data will be processed. Then Security+Legal will produce attestation and SOC2 bundle.

Sam (AE): On it. I'll post their reply here when I have it.
